g.text: Sequence Diagram - UC-11 - Configure Application Settings
edit goal/theme/notifications/retention or request data action
Export returns JSON or a ZIP of CSV files. Clear history deletes only
completed/abandoned sessions and preserves settings and any active session.
Clear-history and delete-all are separate confirmed commands. Clear-history
removes completed/abandoned sessions and their intervals, preserving the
active session and settings. Delete-all stops any active session, removes
personal data including profiles and outbox events, then recreates defaults.
Settings changes apply to new sessions.
The active session keeps its snapshotted settings.
